summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026, reporting a consolidated disclosure of director and related-party transactions under CVM Resolution 44/21. The filing details shareholdings and trading activity by board members, management, fiscal council, and controlling shareholders during the month. There are no terms of a special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. The report is a routine periodic disclosure of insider transactions, not tied to any structural corporate event or forced departure.
